description: DRAFT: may change until published. A band's confirmation or dispute of an event it plays. A trust upgrade, never a publication gate: unconfirmed events are still listed. The indexer counts it only if BOTH hold: the author's DID is on the event's accepted fm.tba.lineup, AND that DID has claimed its TBA band entry (verification ladder). Otherwise a lister could put a puppet account on the lineup and confirm from it. If a band writes several, the most recently received wins (by repo commit order, not createdAt, which the writer controls); deleting the record retracts it.

subject.description: The community.lexicon.calendar.event. The CID pins the exact version confirmed; if the event is edited later, TBA shows 'confirmed an earlier version' until the band re-confirms.

note.description: Optional public note, e.g. why it's disputed ('we're not playing this show', 'date moved to 14 March').

confirmed.description: The band confirms it plays this event as listed.

disputed.description: The band says the listing is wrong.
